text: Iran’s IRGC says it launched ballistic missiles at a U.S. aircraft carrier and destroyer, claiming the warships were involved in actions against Iranian vessels. The IRGC said the ships were damaged and withdrew from the area, and warned of further responses if hostile actions continue.
text_zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）称其向一艘美国航空母舰和一艘驱逐舰发射了弹道导弹，声称这些军舰参与了针对伊朗船只的行动。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，这些舰船已受损并撤离该地区，并警告称如果敌对行动继续，将采取进一步回应。

text: Nuno Felix RT @michaeldweiss : Stark contrast with what the Director of Central Intelligence, who is far more read into Russia’s military and economic situation than Witkoff and Kushner are, came to Moscow to discuss. This was a set piece written and directed by Putin: bring Trump’s hapless idiots to Russia for a gauzy photo op, not to discuss an end to the war but to reiterate the same propaganda, hoping they return home and can convince their master it is true, whatever Ratcliffe says to the contrary on the links. Lot of dooming and teeth-gnashing over this visit, but so far it’s the same performance we’ve seen before, with perhaps a touch more sycophantic stupidity from Dim Philby. Will they next turn up in Kyiv? Who knows. Will it make a difference? Don’t hold your breath. After the midterms both of these “envoys” stand a reasonable chance of having their lives turned inside-out by long overdue Congressional inquiries into their diplomacy-as-enterprise side hustle. So one can see how both they and the Russians are keen to notch a geopolitical victory before the House flips. Doesn’t mean one is in the offing, however. Putin told U.S. Envoys Witkoff and Kushner that Russia would achieve its goals, saying that the root causes of the war in Ukraine need to be resolved. - REUTERS - Faytuks Network tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 转推 @michaeldweiss：这与中央情报局局长来莫斯科讨论的内容形成了鲜明对比，他对俄罗斯军事和经济状况的了解远比威特科夫和库什纳深入。这是一场由普京编导的样板戏：把特朗普那群笨蛋带到俄罗斯进行一场朦胧的摆拍，不是为了讨论结束战争，而是为了重申同样的宣传，希望他们回国后能说服他们的主人相信这是真的，无论拉特克利夫（Ratcliffe）在这些联系上说了什么。关于这次访问有很多悲观和咬牙切齿的评论，但到目前为止，这只是我们以前见过的同一场表演，或许还带有一点“笨蛋菲尔比”（Dim Philby）那种阿谀奉承的愚蠢。他们接下来会出现在基辅吗？谁知道呢。这会有什么不同吗？别抱太大希望。中期选举后，这两位“特使”都有很大可能因为国会迟迟未进行的关于他们“外交即生意”副业的调查而生活被彻底翻转。所以人们可以看出他们和俄罗斯人为何都急于在众议院变天前取得地缘政治胜利。然而，这并不意味着胜利即将到来。普京告诉美国特使威特科夫和库什纳，俄罗斯将实现其目标，并称乌克兰战争的根本原因需要得到解决。 - 路透社 - Faytuks Network 推文

text: Nuno Felix RT @RubizhBrigade : What the hell is going on at POKROVSK direction?? Russian invaders seem to be pooling reserves for further advances. As usual, they are trying to infiltrate as deeply as possible into residential areas. Or what's left of them. We don't make it easy for them. Every day we "decommission" anywhere from 3 to 20 enemy soldiers. Fun fact - many POWs we take near our strongpoints claim they were told that the area had no Ukrainian presence. Basically, Russian command lies to their soldiers, and sends them on a suicide-scouting-infiltrating missions. At the same time, they really want our logistics gone. Hence the drone spam. Last Sunday, we had about 300(!) enemy drones in our are of responsibility. Usually, smoking out the infiltrated Russian infantry isn't that big of an issue. But it is a lot harder once you also have to dodge enemy drones on your search-and-destroy missions. Interestingly, Russians had also pulled their artillery closer to the frontline. Perhaps, they find that their current pace of advance unacceptable and feel like risking their artillery. Suffice to say - we've got plenty of boring videos of our drone pilots blowing them to kingdom come. Cherry on top - while our logistics are a nightmare, so it is for the Russians. They have to lug all their equipment and supplies primarily on foot, just as we do. After all, two can play at the drone-shut-down-the-logistics game :D tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 转推 @RubizhBrigade：波克罗夫斯克（POKROVSK）方向到底发生了什么？？俄罗斯入侵者似乎正在集结预备队以进一步推进。像往常一样，他们试图尽可能深入地渗透到居民区。或者说，渗透到剩下的那些地方。我们不会让他们轻易得逞。我们每天“清除”3到20名敌军士兵。有趣的事实是——我们在据点附近俘虏的许多战俘声称，他们被告知该地区没有乌克兰军队。基本上，俄罗斯指挥部对他们的士兵撒谎，并派他们执行自杀式的侦察渗透任务。与此同时，他们非常希望切断我们的后勤补给。因此出现了无人机轰炸。上周日，在我们的责任区内大约有300(!)架敌方无人机。通常，清理渗透进来的俄罗斯步兵并不是什么大问题。但当你还要在搜寻和摧毁任务中躲避敌方无人机时，难度就大多了。有趣的是，俄罗斯人还将他们的火炮拉近了前线。也许他们觉得目前的推进速度无法接受，并觉得有必要冒险使用火炮。不用多说——我们有大量无聊的视频，记录了我们的无人机飞行员将他们炸得粉身碎骨。最棒的是——虽然我们的后勤是场噩梦，但俄罗斯人也一样。他们必须像我们一样，主要靠步行来搬运所有的装备和补给。毕竟，切断后勤的无人机游戏两个人都能玩 :D 推文

text: OSINTdefender U.S. Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have departed Moscow after roughly three hours of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin focused on ending the war in Ukraine. The two are expected in Kyiv on Sunday to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as part of the Trump administration’s latest push to revive stalled peace negotiations. Putin has ordered a 72 hour pause in strikes on Kyiv during their visit. Witkoff and Kushner are now aboard U.S. Air Force C-32A SAM934. They will likely travel to Poland before continuing by ground transportation to Kyiv. tweet
text_zh: OSINTdefender：美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了约三个小时的会谈后已离开莫斯科，会谈重点是结束乌克兰战争。作为特朗普政府重启停滞不前的和平谈判的最新努力的一部分，两人预计将于周日抵达基辅会见乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基。普京已下令在他们访问期间暂停对基辅的打击72小时。威特科夫和库什纳目前乘坐美国空军C-32A SAM934专机。他们可能会先前往波兰，然后通过陆路交通继续前往基辅。推文

text: 🇷🇺 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 Key Takeaways From Ushakov's Comments on the Witkoff-Kushner Visit ➡️ The meeting was substantive, constructive, and extremely candid. ➡️ Putin's talks with the American negotiators ran 3 hours and 10 minutes. ➡️ Witkoff and Kushner promised to bring Putin's assessments on paths to a settlement into their meetings in Kiev tomorrow. ➡️ The US side came thoroughly prepared and had formulated a number of considerations on ways to resolve the conflict. ➡️ Putin and Trump will maintain personal contact, and work through Witkoff and Kushner will also continue. ➡️ Putin highlighted Russian military successes in the special military operation and expressed confidence in achieving its goals. ➡️ Putin stressed the need to eliminate all root causes of the Ukrainian conflict and reaffirmed his commitment to continued joint work with the US toward a political and diplomatic resolution. ➡️ Witkoff and Kushner "took note" of Putin's remarks that Kiev has stopped hiding its true nature, reburying Nazis. ➡️ Talks weren't limited to Ukraine; possible major Russian-American projects were also discussed. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
text_zh: 🇷🇺 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 乌沙科夫就威特科夫-库什纳访问发表评论的要点 ➡️ 会谈内容充实、富有建设性且极其坦诚。 ➡️ 普京与美方谈判代表的会谈持续了3小时10分钟。 ➡️ 威特科夫和库什纳承诺将普京关于解决途径的评估带入他们明天在基辅的会议中。 ➡️ 美方做了充分准备，并就解决冲突的方式提出了一些考量。 ➡️ 普京和特朗普将保持个人联系，通过威特科夫和库什纳进行的工作也将继续。 ➡️ 普京强调了俄罗斯在特别军事行动中取得的军事成就，并对实现目标充满信心。 ➡️ 普京强调需要消除乌克兰冲突的所有根源，并重申致力于与美国继续共同努力，以实现政治和外交解决。 ➡️ 威特科夫和库什纳“注意到”普京关于基辅已不再掩盖其真实本质、重新安葬纳粹分子的言论。 ➡️ 会谈不仅限于乌克兰；双方还讨论了可能开展的重大俄美项目。 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner BREAKING | 🇬🇧 🇦🇷 ‼️ ‼️ Nigel Farage’s Reform UK has issued an unusually blunt warning to Buenos Aires, saying a Farage-led government would be prepared to use British military power to “crush” Argentina if a new conflict erupted over the Falkland Islands. According to POLITICO, a Reform UK spokesperson said Farage would deploy Britain’s armed forces and impose economic sanctions to defend the islands if he were Prime Minister. The spokesperson added that a Reform government would use “every lever of the British state” against Argentina in any confrontation over the territory. The language is deliberately aggressive, but it reinforces Britain’s longstanding position that the Falklands will be defended if challenged by force. Any renewed military confrontation would carry enormous political and strategic consequences for both countries, making deterrence far preferable to another war. For London, maintaining credible defenses around the islands remains the strongest way to ensure that sovereignty disputes stay diplomatic rather than return to the battlefield. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet
text_zh: ↩️ 回复 OSINT Visioner 突发 | 🇬🇧 🇦🇷 ‼️ ‼️ 奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）领导的英国改革党向布宜诺斯艾利斯发出了不同寻常的直白警告，称如果福克兰群岛爆发新的冲突，法拉奇领导的政府将准备动用英国军事力量“粉碎”阿根廷。据《政客》（POLITICO）报道，英国改革党发言人表示，如果法拉奇担任首相，他将部署英国武装部队并实施经济制裁以保卫这些岛屿。该发言人补充说，在任何关于该领土的对抗中，改革党政府都将动用“英国国家的一切手段”来对付阿根廷。这种措辞虽然刻意具有攻击性，但它强化了英国的一贯立场，即如果福克兰群岛受到武力挑战，英国将予以保卫。任何新的军事对抗都将给两国带来巨大的政治和战略后果，因此威慑远比再次爆发战争更可取。对于伦敦而言，保持岛屿周围可靠的防御力量仍然是确保主权争端保持在外交层面而非重返战场的最有力方式。与我们一起查看最新动态：@visionergeo 推文

text_zh: OSINTdefender 在美国针对三艘伊朗油轮采取行动后，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）回应称，伊朗革命卫队海军今天在霍尔木兹海峡瞄准了六艘油轮。来自伊朗新闻媒体的额外报道现在也称，如果此类袭击继续，伊朗革命卫队威胁将对该地区采取更多行动。推文

text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner BIG | 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ “Putin brought the war back to Russia.” EU Defence Commissioner Andrius Kubilius says Moscow’s own escalation is increasingly exposing Russian territory and institutions to the consequences of the war the Kremlin launched against Ukraine. Responding to Russia’s September 4 drone strike on the Security Service of Ukraine headquarters in central Kyiv, Kubilius said Putin continues to escalate while Ukraine answers with mirror measures. He pointed to the destruction of Russian oil-refining capacity and disruption of international aviation, adding that Russian intelligence services should now be wondering when a Ukrainian drone could reach their own offices. Kubilius is highlighting a strategic shift Moscow spent years trying to prevent. Russia sought to wage a devastating war inside Ukraine while keeping its own strategic rear largely insulated, but Ukraine’s growing long-range capabilities have steadily eroded that sanctuary. Continued Russian attacks on Ukrainian state institutions only strengthen Kyiv’s political case for striking assets that support Moscow’s war machine and forcing Russia to absorb more of the costs of its own aggression. text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner ‼️ ‼️ 🇺🇸 🇷🇺 BIG | Republican strategist Rick Wilson says Donald Trump’s fixation on Vladimir Putin has left the U.S. president fundamentally unable to treat Russia as the adversary it is, while Putin has spent years exploiting that weakness to Moscow’s advantage. Wilson, a prominent American political consultant and former Republican media strategist, argues that Trump genuinely believes Putin considers him a friend, admires him and views Russia as an unbeatable global power. Putin, Wilson says, sees the relationship very differently and regards Trump as someone who can be manipulated with relative ease. He described the Russian leader’s intelligence background as central to that dynamic and argued that Putin has been successfully manipulating Trump for roughly a decade. The consequences now extend far beyond Trump’s personal fascination with Putin. Washington is again pursuing negotiations with Moscow while Russia continues its war against Ukraine, and every concession made without corresponding Russian compromises risks reinforcing Putin’s belief that persistence pays. A U.S. strategy built around personal chemistry with the Kremlin rather than leverage, military strength and sustained support for Ukraine weakens both Kyiv and NATO. Putin has repeatedly demonstrated that he responds to pressure far more reliably than flattery, yet Trump’s approach continues to give Moscow reasons to believe otherwise. text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner ‼️ ‼️ 🇪🇺 🇷🇺 BIG | NATO planners are increasingly worried that Europe may not be politically or militarily prepared to sustain a prolonged war with Russia, even as Moscow continues testing the continent through military pressure and hybrid operations. According to The Guardian, sources close to NATO planning describe growing “military pessimism” about Europe’s ability to withstand a long conflict with Russia. The concerns are being driven in part by the growing popularity of right-wing and Russia-friendly political forces in several European countries, alongside Washington’s rapid reduction of support for the U.S. military presence and broader security commitments on the continent. Europe has spent years warning about the Russian threat while moving far too slowly on the capabilities needed to survive a major war. Higher defense budgets are important, but they mean little without ammunition stockpiles, industrial-scale production, trained manpower, resilient infrastructure and political unity. With Washington becoming less reliable under Trump and Russia continuing to probe NATO through sabotage, cyber operations and drone incidents, European governments have less room than ever to postpone serious military preparation. За сутки сбито меньше сотни дронов, так мало пусков не фиксировалось со времен майского перемирия. Тем не менее в приграничье ситуация не изменилась: массированные налеты на ЛНР , ДНР Запорожскую , Белгородскую и Херсонскую области продолжаются. ➡️ На Дружковском направлении российские войска завязали бои за Куртовку . text: Residents of Bezmer, a Bulgarian village beside a military airbase, have felt relief after two U.S. Air Force refuelling planes left the country. Their deployment had sparked weeks of anxiety because Iran had warned Bulgaria against allowing its territory to support U.S. and Israeli military operations, raising fears that the base could become a potential target. More than 3,000 people from Bezmer and nearby villages signed petitions against the deployment and held peaceful protests. Many residents said they felt caught in a conflict they had no control over, especially because local families have relatives working at the base. Bulgarian officials insisted the security risk was extremely low and said the aircraft were mainly involved in NATO training and exercises. Source: Al Jazeera
text_zh: 保加利亚一个军事空军基地旁的村庄Bezmer的居民在两架美国空军加油机离开该国后感到如释重负。它们的部署引发了数周的焦虑，因为伊朗曾警告保加利亚不得允许其领土支持美国和以色列的军事行动，这引发了人们对该基地可能成为潜在目标的担忧。来自Bezmer及附近村庄的3000多人签署了反对部署的请愿书，并举行了和平抗议。许多居民表示，他们感到被卷入了一场自己无法控制的冲突中，尤其是因为当地家庭有亲戚在基地工作。保加利亚官员坚称安全风险极低，并表示这些飞机主要参与北约的训练和演习。来源：半岛电视台
